The ear tips also show a slight diffusion-like softness against the background. The topology auditor's high mask confidence (0.97) suggests the overall silhouette is coherent, but it does not rule out the subtle boundary melting observed by the Router. The pose auditor found minimal risk, but the low confidence on the right ear keypoint (0.17) correlates with the Router's texture observation. The severity of the paw artifact is significant enough to warrant a deduction, as it affects the anatomical realism of the subject's interaction with the environment.
